summary: Iteration 27 — Visual regression + sanity for the Skali synth/neon restyle (Club Flyer profiles, Night Drive live, Pocket Synth bottom bar/messages, Holo Analytics). Tested at mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x800 as creator@skali.test and fan@skali.test (POST /api/auth/login → access_token, stored at localStorage.cc_token). All acceptance criteria pass. No horizontal overflow at 390px on /, /messages, /u/creator, /live, /creator/analytics (scrollWidth == clientWidth = 390 in every case). Global: body font-family = 'Outfit, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'; .profile-flyer-title computes to 'Anton, Impact, Outfit, sans-serif' uppercase 30px — both fonts load. body::before and body::after pointer-events = 'none' so ambient glow + grain do not block clicks. Mobile bottom-nav (data-testid=bottom-nav) renders as a floating glass pill with all six testids present (bottom-nav-feed/find/create/messages/activity/me). Tapping bottom-nav-create from /messages correctly navigates to / and opens the composer (textarea becomes visible). Composer stays reachable above the pill (not clipped). Desktop sidebar renders (Feed/Find/Messages/Activity/Groups/My Profile/Connections/Settings/Reels + big New Post button) and bottom-nav is hidden (is_visible=False at 1920). Profile (Club Flyer): #CREATOR large uppercase Anton title, profile-stat-blocks (Followers/Following), CREATOR sticker, creator-studio tile with profile-add-story + creator-studio-analytics tiles, tabs Media/Wall/Boards/Audio switch. As fan: Follow + profile-live-alert-toggle (toggles 'Live alerts on' → 'Live alerts off' and persists), Message, 'In your Inner Circle' sticker, profile-subscribe-btn, profile-tip-btn all visible and clickable. Live (Night Drive): /live renders tag chips (All/Gaming/Just Chatting/Music/Creative/IRL/Sports), 'Live Now 0' empty state, replays-section with the obstest01 'Test stream' card (30m, 19h left), 'Your past streams' section. /watch/obstest01 shows ended state 'This stream has ended / No recording is available' and the chat aside with 'Chat is closed' message (Supabase storage disabled in preview — expected). Messages: list page shows Groups + Me, Myself & I rows (creator has no DM conversations — DMs are tier-gated, as documented). Analytics (Holo): /creator/analytics tabs Overview/Subscribers/Shop/Finance/Creator Health all present (data-testid analytics-tab-*), range picker (analytics-range-picker/month/3m/all) renders. overview-trend-chart is an <svg> with 2 <path> children (line + area fill) — now a real SVG line chart. Creator Health panel shows Returning subscribers 24, Renewal rate 86.4% as a glowing purple ring gauge (data-testid=health-renewal-rate), Avg watch time 0.5 min, Retention 91.2% as a glowing cyan ring gauge (data-testid=health-retention), Messages from Inner Circle 132. health-toggle switch works. No visual breakage, overlaps, or clipped elements observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Follow button on the other-profile view does not expose a data-testid (buttons for Live alerts, Subscribe, Tip, Message all do). Adding data-testid='profile-follow-btn' would make the Follow/Unfollow toggle automatable like the sibling actions.
overview-trend-chart <svg> has no viewBox-based <title>/<desc> or role='img' — minor a11y gap for the Holo line chart.
The health-renewal-rate / health-retention ring gauges only convey % via color + text; a sr-only label (e.g. 'Renewal rate 86.4%') on the ring SVG would help screen readers.

Login response field is 'access_token' (not 'token'); the review-request copy says 'token in localStorage cc_token' which is correct for the stored key but could confuse future agents — worth noting in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
test_credentials: creator@skali.test / fan@skali.test / owner@skali.test / mod@skali.test — password Test1234!. Token field in /api/auth/login response is 'access_token'; stored at localStorage.cc_token.
seed_data_creation: None. Toggled profile-live-alert-toggle on/off for fan→creator (ended in 'off' state after test; may need to be flipped back to 'on' manually if next iteration expects default-on). Pre-existing obstest01 replay used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login API returns {access_token, token_type, user} — not {token}. Set localStorage.cc_token = access_token after visiting origin. Preview env has LiveKit disabled (/api/live/start → 500) and Supabase storage disabled (vod playback_url empty) — both expected. The restyle regression surface is: body font (Outfit), display font (Anton via .font-display / .profile-flyer-title), body::before/::after must keep pointer-events:none, bottom-nav floating glass pill at 390px only, SVG overview-trend-chart, Ring gauge health-renewal-rate + health-retention. All currently pass.
